presentation.name: Heighliner
presentation.subtitle: Human in command
presentation.revision: The Drummer front door with its transit gate rebuilt as a hoop with depth, drawn at the screen's own resolution, and rooms that play their films in place.

statement: V44 Heighliner gives the Drummer front door and its seven stations in the platinum cAshIo identity a transit gate rebuilt with real depth and drawn at the screen's own resolution, with Bit and the maps as redrawn in Bitmaxing. The gate is generative artwork. The helm and E.V.E. are scripted browser experiences that send no requests. Observation records and historical releases retain their original dates, versions and limits.
